body:
I would allow very precise adjustments directly, without needing to adjust **Default Float Step** in the Editor Settings:

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::FLOAT, "pixel_size", PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE, "0.0001,128,0.0000001,suffix:m"), "set_pixel_size", "get_pixel_size");
```

`0.0000001` roughly matches the 32-bit float precision limit for values between `0.0` and `1.0`, so it's pretty precise already.

In the long run, the editor setting may be deprecated in favor of a more flexible solution, as per https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3524.

Note that your PR currently doesn't adjust the lower bound, so it doesn't allow you to enter values smaller than `0.0001` regardless of this change.

I've added the suggested precision.

Great to see that a more general solution is on the way.

I found this particular node to be so central, I hope the bandaid helps others in the meantime.
